rules.status: written before any part 2 pool or score exists; part 2 has not run
rules.source: in/v3/KIT_SPEC_mask_phrase_v2.md (Bars, Part 2; GPU budget and stops) and in/v2/KIT_SPEC_mask_phrase.md (the same three bars)
rules.contrast: summarize_train.contrast: paired row MRA difference, 10,000 room-cluster draws, seed 20261119, 95% percentile interval

arms.W_cf: part 1 arm W1 as priced in out/PER_ITEM.jsonl (stored alias pools); the chosen part 1 arm
arms.W_exact: part 1 W1 fold policies unchanged; each non-raw phrase's pool is its SAM 3 rerun alone (out/pool_part2), raw-name pools stay the stored ones (parity)
arms.W_new: candidate phrases per name = rerun dictionary aliases plus NEW_PHRASES.json phrases (sha256 in part2/NEW_PHRASES.sha256), each pool its rerun alone; the part 1 fold rule (strictly more fit objects on target, ties to sorted phrase order, at least five fit objects) picks one phrase per name per fold
arms.R_cond: on top of the best of W_exact and W_new by MRA (ties to W_exact): in an anchor frame where the policy's phrase keeps no candidate, keep that call's queries with conditional score >= 0.5, at most 5, all with the call's one presence for that frame

bars.exact_holds: W_exact minus W_cf: 95% lower bound above -1.0
bars.new_worth: W_new minus W_exact at least +1.0 type points with lower bound above 0, and phrase_safe holds for W_new (W_new minus A0 on the both-good rows: lower bound above -1.0); MISSING (counts as not passed) when the new-phrase pass is dropped
bars.retention_worth: R_cond minus the best W arm at least +1.0 with lower bound above 0, and phrase_safe holds for R_cond; adoption needs a seal review in addition

rules.both_good_rows: the rows whose two operands are both good under A0 (part 1 recomputed 456)

gpu.card: one 48 GB card placed by swarm_build3, two empty nvidia-smi readings 5 minutes apart, under vnice.sh, off trinity-0-13
gpu.projection: after the first 10 captures out/TIMING_RECEIPT.json projects the whole pass; above 1.2 GPU-h the new phrases are dropped for the remaining captures (new_worth MISSING); still above 1.2 the pass stops

rules.gate: dry-run step 5 (out/pool_part2/STEP5.json PASS) before any part 2 pool is trusted
never: choosing anything from dev-S1, held-out, R0-dev or official outcomes
pricing a pool whose anchor frame mixes presences
reusing A0 candidate ids or labels
